The '''Jolly Spacer''' was an [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] space. A group of adventurers were eating lunch in the establishment when they were approached by [[Lazarus Armand]] in regards to transporting a cargo to the [[Kalinda system/Legends|Kalinda system]].
